task_name: World 471 Task B  -  Asymmetric Summary-Tab Termination Clearance & Mid-Plan-Year Dependent Shift
prompt: Review the Summary_Residuals_And_Guardian schedule in `benadmin_ease_vs_payroll_nov2026.xlsx`. Quantify residual terminated medical rows and open payroll deductions, compute clean employer Dental and Vision costs, calculate the per-pay-period, monthly, and annual savings from shifting dependent Dental and Vision from half to full employee-paid, and state the Section 125 plan-year and W-2 Box 12 Code DD controls.

rubric.description: Identifies $846.21 per pay period ($330.61 ER + $515.60 EE, or $1,833.46 monthly) of residual terminated medical rows still Active on the Summary tab and $389.02 per pay period of open payroll MDCL deductions.
Computes clean employer Guardian costs of $671.95 per pay period ($1,455.89 monthly) for Dental and $94.75 per pay period ($205.29 monthly) for Vision across 27 active enrollees.

Quantifies the 50% to 100% employee-paid dependent shift from $215.82 per pay period ($195.29 Dental + $20.53 Vision, $467.61 monthly) to $431.74 per pay period ($390.61 Dental + $41.13 Vision, $935.44 monthly), saving $5,613.92 annually.

Verifies that mid-plan-year dependent contribution changes respect the 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 Section 125 plan year and that terminated employees stop ongoing post-termination deductions and W-2 Box 12 Code DD employer accruals while preserving valid YTD coverage.
